contexts.text: They referred the lowest natural things to the sole.
The sole, and the heel, in the Word, = the ultimate Natural. ( = the lowest natural things. AC 2162:2. AC 4938.)
The Hells are in planes in every direction under the soles.
Those who are at the soles are the grosser natural Spirits.
Spirits who appeared in the plane of the sole of the foot.
They act into the sole of the right foot.
Under the soles of the feet are those also who have lived for the world and self-gratification. Described. SE 2683.
They who have lived a delicate life conjoined with interior cunning are under the sole of the right foot, deep down there...
Many have abodes under the soles of the feet. Described.
All that place is called the prison house which is proximately beneath and around the sole of the foot, where those are kept who are in vastation...
The Hells of the magicians are in a plane beneath the soles...
A great stream (of people from the worlds) in the plane of the sole of the foot.
The middle Natural is signified by the soles; the external, by the shoes.
The Spirits of our Earth... are kept in places which are beneath the soles of the feet, and are called the Lower Earth... AC 7090. AC 8099:2.
The places at the sides beneath the soles of the feet, where evil Spirits are...
As the ultimate of the Natural is signified by the hoof, as by the sole, there is also signified the truth which is ultimate of the Natural.
(Those represented by the Philistines) dwell to the right in front in a plane under the sole.
The soles, which are under the feet, = the ultimates of nature. Treated of.
The soles, etc. correspond to the ultimates of Heaven, in which there is power.
The First Heaven forms the feet down to the soles...
Infernal delight... inflows into every man, but into the soles of the feet, etc.
The sole of the right foot = such corporeal things as they adhere to.
On a tumult beneath the sole of the left foot.
(They who live securely) dwell near the sole of the left foot, holding the region of the sole of the left foot. Described.
These hold the region of the sole of the foot, because they despise others in comparison with themselves, although they are not evil...
(Such) at last come beneath the sole of the right foot.
The undulation extended itself towards the sole, and under the sole of the foot; by which is signified the extreme grossness of their phantasies.
He was afterwards let down under the sole of the left foot, almost to the Hell there.
(Wolff) was in the plane of the sole of the left foot.
(The Moravians) appeared a little to the right, in the plane of the sole of the foot.
There were two... at the region of the sole. Described.
The region where the Mohammedans are is towards the right in the plane of the right sole.
They were cast into a Hell almost under the sole of the right foot.
The Hell of such is under the sole of the left foot...
There is another London... in the plane of the sole of the foot, a little to the right.
The Jews appeared to the right, in a plane under the soles.
All the interiors cease... progressively from head to sole...
On those who constitute the soles of the feet, and on those beneath them.
See Foot.
This ultimate part of Heaven corresponds to the soles of the feet.
The Sensuous Natural corresponds to the soles of the feet...
The very soles of the feet correspond to the world, in which everything is natural. (The feet correspond to the First Heaven.)
Under Trample, see this reference.
As man becomes wise... the sensuous mind is as the soles of the foot.
